sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: Q3eSE_LS0_U05_02_Listening1_ActivitiesA_D_E.
sentences.arabic: Q3eSE_LS0_U05_02_Listening1_ActivitiesA_D_E
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Q3eSE_LS0_U05_02_Listening1_ActivitiesA_D_E.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: Wow, you guys look tired.
sentences.arabic: واو، أنتم تبدو عليكم علامات التعب.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Wow, you guys look tired.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: Which one did you like the best?
sentences.arabic: أي واحدة أعجبتك أكثر؟
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Which one did you like the best.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: It’s across the street from school.
sentences.arabic: هي عبر الشارع من المدرسة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/It’s across the street from school.mp3

sentences.speaker: Karen:
sentences.english: The rent is expensive, though.
sentences.arabic: الإيجار باهظ الثمن، رغم ذلك.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The rent is expensive, though.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: We can get another roommate.
sentences.arabic: يمكننا أن نحصل على زميل سكن آخر.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/We can get another roommate.mp3

sentences.speaker: Karen:
sentences.english: and the neighbors seem nice.
sentences.arabic: ويبدو أن الجيران لطفاء
sentences.audio: assets/audio/and the neighbors seem nice.mp3

sentences.speaker: Karen:
sentences.english: The beach is far from campus
sentences.arabic: الشاطئ بعيد عن الحرم الجامعي
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The beach is far from campus.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: Yes, but there’s a lot of public transportation.
sentences.arabic: نعم، لكن هناك الكثير من وسائل النقل العام.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Yes, but there’s a lot of public transportation.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: It takes 15 minutes to get to campus on the bus.
sentences.arabic: يستغرق 15 دقيقة للوصول إلى الحرم الجامعي بالحافلة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/It takes 15 minutes to get to campus on the bus.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: The rent is really cheap, too.
sentences.arabic: والإيجار منخفض جداً، أيضاً.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The rent is really cheap, too.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: Well, there’s one big problem with that one.
sentences.arabic: حسنًا، هناك مشكلة كبيرة مع ذلك.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Well, there’s one big problem with that one.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: It’s a studio
sentences.arabic: إنها studio
sentences.audio: assets/audio/It’s a studio.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: A studio isn’t very private.
sentences.arabic: الstudio ليس خاصًا جدًا.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/A studio isn’t very private.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: How about the apartment downtown?
sentences.arabic: ماذا عن الشقة في وسط المدينة?
sentences.audio: assets/audio/How about the apartment downtown.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: The rooms are small, but they’re comfortable.
sentences.arabic: الغرف صغيرة، لكنها مريحة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The rooms are small, but they’re comfortable.mp3

sentences.speaker: Karen:
sentences.english: The rent is cheap, and it’s close to a lot of shops and restaurants
sentences.arabic: الإيجار رخيص، وهو قريب من الكثير من المتاجر والمطاعم
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The rent is cheap, and it’s close to a lot of shops and restaurants.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: But it’s really noisy
sentences.arabic: لكنها قوية الضوضاء
sentences.audio: assets/audio/But it’s really noisy.mp3

sentences.speaker: Karen:
sentences.english: You can hear all the noises from the street in that apartment.
sentences.arabic: يمكنك أن تسمع جميع الأصوات من الشارع في تلك الشقة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/You can hear all the noises from the street in that apartment.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: Yeah, but it’s close to public transportation.
sentences.arabic: نعم، لكنها قريبة من وسائل النقل العام.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Yeah, but it’s close to public transportation.mp3

sentences.speaker: Atifa:
sentences.english: Why don’t you just live in the dormitory  again next year
sentences.arabic: لماذا لا تعيش في السكن الجامعي مرة أخرى السنة المقبلة؟
sentences.audio: assets/audio/Why don’t you just live in the dormitory  again next year.mp3

sentences.speaker: Karen:
sentences.english: The dorms are fun, but I want a private room.
sentences.arabic: السكن الجامعي ممتع، لكنني أريد غرفة خاصة.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/The dorms are fun, but I want a private room.mp3

sentences.speaker: Lisa:
sentences.english: But I don’t know which apartment to choose.
sentences.arabic: لكنني لا أعرف أي شقة أختار.
sentences.audio: assets/audio/But I don’t know which apartment to choose.mp3
